charts.title: Actual observer RMS at r=1 m
charts.description: Only supplied z=0 observers at equal radius and common time support. Discrete samples: no swept native directivity or interpolated angular evidence.

charts.title: Distance ratios on actual observer rays
charts.description: AC RMS at matched emission times t-r/c, with interpolation only inside support. Native Curle has no delay, so uses its original source clock. These models compare one actual receiver pair, not independent experiments. Reactive 1/r² and radiating 1/r references are shown; neither is fitted. The table reports signed residuals from the reactive reference. Do not apply a radiating 20log10(r) correction to reactive total pressure.

charts.title: Ideal source RMS directivity
charts.description: Ideal sources, not computed cylinder contributions. Individually normalized far-field patterns; strengths have different units. Quadrupole shown is one tensor choice, not the directivity of every quadrupole.

charts.title: Ideal signed far-field patterns
charts.description: Ideal sources, not computed cylinder contributions. Individually normalized far-field patterns; strengths have different units. Quadrupole shown is one tensor choice, not the directivity of every quadrupole.

charts.title: A 1 N harmonic point force: near and radiating terms
charts.description: Analytical dipole on axis, not computed cylinder pressure. Near and far terms are in temporal quadrature for a sinusoid; RMS totals do not add linearly. Equality at kr=1.

charts.title: Retardation is a delay, not an amplitude fit
charts.description: Infinite-duration harmonic teaching source, not computed cylinder data. Actual finite records are never zero-extended to create arrival history.
